result.stdout:
Description:
  Generate a ZeroAllocRestClient interface from an OpenAPI spec

Usage:
  ZeroAlloc.Rest.Tools generate [options]

Options:
  --spec <spec>            Path or URL to OpenAPI spec
  --namespace <namespace>  C# namespace for generated interface
  --output <output>        Output .cs file path
  --interface <interface>  Interface name [default: IApiClient]
  --nowarn <nowarn>        Warning codes to suppress, such as ZRT001; repeat the option or separate codes with ',' or ';'
  --models                 Generate a type for each schema the interface references; false keeps your own DTOs
  -?, -h, --help           Show help and usage information
